description: Get the AnyForge analysis summary for a single repo (coverage %, architecture red/amber/green counts, open gap count, languages) to assess its relevance and distance from the program goal. Returns `analyzed: false` with a note when the repo has no analysis yet — it can still be scoped in. Call this for the handful of repos you are unsure about, NOT for every repo in a large org.

repoFullName.description: The "owner/name" repo, exactly as listed by anyforge_list_repo_index.

name: anyforge_get_repo_analysis
title: Get repo analysis
